title: Large Language Models have Chain-of-Affective LLMs-CoA

measurement_description: The paper's benchmarks and evaluations do not measure any aspects of faith or religion. They focus on measuring the affective dynamics, emotional states, and psychological profiles of Large Language Models, such as aggression, depression, anxiety, and frustration.
